title: Omnicit.EntraRBAC naming standard
description: Naming standard read by Test-OERStructure -NamingStandard. A name is split at the separator into segments, and each segment is checked against its entry in segments. The check is advisory: a name that breaks the standard is a Warning, never an Error.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, for editor support.

description.description: Free text describing the standard. Not used by the check.

separator.description: The text that separates the segments of a name. It is compared as written, never as a pattern.

maxLength.description: The longest name allowed, in characters. Omit it for no limit.

sections.description: The document sections the standard applies to. assignmentPolicies are the policies of the accessPackages entries.

includeSyncedGroups.description: When true, a group synchronized from on-premises (onPremisesSynced true) is checked too. By default it is skipped, since Invoke-OERStructure writes nothing to it.

segments.description: The ordered segments of a name. A segment with optional true may be left out; the segments that are present keep this order.

name.description: The segment's name, used in findings.

description.description: Free text describing the segment. Not used by the check.

values.description: A closed list of the allowed values, compared as exact, case-sensitive text and never as patterns. No value may contain the separator. Use values or pattern, not both.

pattern.description: A .NET regular expression the whole segment must match (it is anchored at both ends, so Fin does not match Finance), case-sensitive unless it starts with (?i). Use values or pattern, not both.

case.description: The letter case of the segment: PascalCase is an uppercase letter first and then only letters and digits, camelCase a lowercase letter first and then only letters and digits, UPPERCASE no lowercase letter, lowercase no uppercase letter. Omit it to allow any case.

optional.description: When true, the segment may be left out of a name.

exceptions.description: Names that keep their names: a name that matches one of these .NET regular expressions in full (anchored at both ends, so All Users does not exempt All Users Copy; case-sensitive unless the entry starts with (?i)) is never checked.
